text.title: Activation Framework Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable activation-funnel signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a tracked product event name plus a window in days that the team calls activation, and an event table it can be queried from?

conclusion.verdict: define one event and one window before anything else; if no event table exists at all, skip
no event data to diagnose; route to instrumentation work first

branch.question: Does a table show D30 retention for users who did versus did not perform the event, with group sizes?

conclusion.verdict: build the comparison on a closed cohort before accepting the event

branch.question: Is a baseline activation rate available for at least four closed signup-week cohorts?

conclusion.verdict: wait for cohorts to close or extend the history; no experiments yet

branch.question: Does every funnel step between signup and the event map to a tracked event?

conclusion.verdict: mark gaps uninstrumented, add instrumentation tasks, report no numbers for them
rank drop-offs by absolute loss, score experiments with ice.py, emit the spec

text.example: event_name_and_window=true -> d30_comparison=true -> closed_cohorts=6 -> all_steps_instrumented=true -> conclusion ref=r-ice-integer-scale-and-formula
